source.accepted_proposal: Keep MP005 only for parameter-by-species candidate coverage, cross-species comparability questions, additional translation inputs and project-specific coverage gaps; reuse MP003 and general data rules.

profile.name: Cross-species data coverage
outputs: Translation-specific missing inputs and required phase
profile.applies_when: The project requests animal-to-human parameter translation. Reuse the per-species input inventory and definitions assessed under MP003 and applicable profiles; assess only the additional cross-species coverage needs.
required_inputs: The existing parameter-by-species input inventory with source and review status; reuse MP003 definitions and DA001/DA004/DA008 handling instead of re-extracting or repeating them.
The project-specific translation objective and any published species-coverage requirement, including the phase at which it applies.
conditional_inputs: Additional correction factors, calibration evidence or other inputs required by a translation approach explicitly considered in the project. Refer binding and in vitro input details to their relevant profiles; do not select a method or require every possible method here.
acceptable_alternatives: Retain the source and review statuses already assigned under MP003. Uncomputed source data and unqualified reported estimates may contribute to candidate coverage without becoming qualified parameters.
data_checks: Summarize candidate coverage separately for each parameter and distinct species. Multiple studies, doses, curves or publications from one species do not create additional species.

Use the existing parameter definitions, units and study metadata to flag cross-species comparability questions. Do not repeat their extraction or silently treat incompatible definitions as interchangeable.
Identify only the extra inputs required by explicitly considered translation approaches; retain unresolved approach-dependent needs as questions for the translation module.

Report candidate coverage against any project-specific species requirement, keeping candidate counts separate from later confirmed qualified-species counts. Do not turn a before-translation requirement into a blocker for supported upstream data preparation or animal analysis.
profile.missing_effect: Report affected parameters, coverage gaps and translation-specific missing material through DA008. Retain supported upstream work; final parameter qualification and species-count acceptance occur before translation.
not_established: A universal species minimum, qualified parameters, an approved extrapolation method or a validated human prediction.
